keys.provenance: Yavin's registry signing key (EXT-20), generated on 2026-10-19 on the maintainer's machine with Node's crypto (Ed25519); the private key is kept outside the repository (%USERPROFILE%\.yavin-registry\signing-key.pem, readable by the maintainer's account only). It signs registry/index.json; it vouches that the index -- and so each package's SHA-256 -- is the one Yavin's maintainers published, not who wrote any extension.
